title: Dehtat
extract:
The Dehtat is a  Puncture-focused Strike used in Zaw construction.

Acquisition
The Dehtat blueprint can be acquired after reaching the Rank of Neutral with the Ostrons and buying it from Hok for  1,000.

Characteristics
This strike primarily deals  Puncture damage

10%  Impact
50%  Puncture
40%  Slash
Compatible weapon types:

Rapier
Polearm
